name: bare-dns

members.name: dns.IPFamily
members.description: The IP address family: `4` for IPv4 or `6` for IPv6.

members.name: dns.lookup
signatures: dns.lookup(hostname: string, cb: (err: Error | null, address: string | null, family: IPFamily | 0) => void): void
dns.lookup(hostname: string, opts: LookupOptions & { all?: false }, cb: (err: Error | null, address: string | null, family: IPFamily | 0) => void): void
dns.lookup(hostname: string, opts: LookupOptions & { all: true }, cb: (err: Error | null, addresses: { address: string; family: IPFamily }[] | null) => void): void
members.description: Resolve `hostname` into an IP address using the operating system's `getaddrinfo` facility, not the DNS protocol directly. With `all: true`, the callback receives every resolved address instead of just the first.

params.name: cb
params.type: (err: Error | null, address: string | null, family: IPFamily | 0) => void
params.description: Called with `(err, address, family)`, or `(err, addresses)` when `all: true`.

members.name: dns.resolveTxt
signatures: dns.resolveTxt(hostname: string, cb: (err: Error | null, records: string[][]) => void): void
members.description: Use the DNS protocol to resolve TXT records for `hostname`. The callback receives an array of records, each itself an array of the strings that make up that record.

params.name: hostname
params.description: The host name to query TXT records for.

params.name: cb
params.description: Called with `(err, records)`; each record is an array of the strings it is made of.

exports.name: LookupOptions

members.name: all
members.description: When `true`, resolve every address for `hostname` instead of just the first. Defaults to `false`.

members.name: family
members.description: Restrict resolution to `4` (IPv4) or `6` (IPv6), or `0` for either. Defaults to `0`.

exports.name: DNSResolver
exports.description: An independent resolver for DNS queries, used to look up TXT records via the DNS protocol.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Cancel any pending queries on this resolver and release its underlying handle.

members.name: resolveTxt
signatures: resolveTxt(hostname: string, cb: (err: Error | null, records: string[][]) => void): void
members.description: Use the DNS protocol to resolve TXT records for `hostname`. The callback receives an array of records, each itself an array of the strings that make up that record.

params.name: hostname
params.description: The host name to query TXT records for.

params.name: cb
params.description: Called with `(err, records)`; each record is an array of the strings it is made of.
